thread.text: The login timeout bug is still happening on mobile safari. Users are getting logged out after 5 mins.
Yeah I saw that too. We need to increase the session TTL and add a keep-alive ping.
Bob can you take that? It's blocking the demo next week.
Staging DB is running out of disk, we're at 87% capacity.
We should probably clean up the old migration snapshots and set up an alert at 80%.
Agreed. And probably worth bumping the volume too before the next release.
We decided in the meeting to go with the new onboarding flow for v2.
Great. Someone needs to update the Figma specs and brief the frontend team.
I can do the Figma update, can you brief frontend Frank?
